C0370.title: GSM Hijacking and SMS Sniffing Used to Steal Verification Codes for Fraud
C0370.summary: In 2018, attackers across multiple regions in China used GSM hijacking and SMS sniffing techniques to intercept SMS verification codes while victims slept. By combining these codes with personally identifiable information obtained through social engineering, they conducted unauthorized transactions and fraudulent online loans.
